# Indian Space Hub Store — Comprehensive LLM Knowledge Base

## Brand Summary
- **Brand**: Indian Space Hub Store
- **Tagline**: Wear India's Space Story
- **Domain**: https://shop.indianspacehub.com
- **Main Portal**: https://indianspacehub.com
- **Owner / Platform**: Indian Space Hub (Kapil Dev Pal)
- **Headquarters / Country**: India (GEO: IN)
- **Primary Language**: English (en-IN)
- **Primary Currency**: INR (₹)

## Product Categories & Catalog Structure
1. **Apparel & Wearables**:
   - Sweatshirts (e.g. ISRO Chandrayaan-3 Black Sweatshirt)
   - Hoodies (e.g. Gaganyaan Crew Limited Edition Hoodie)
   - T-Shirts (Oversized 100% bio-washed super-combed cotton)
   - Available Sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL

2. **Scale Rocket Models & Displays**:
   - LVM3 / GSLV Mk III 1:100 scale model
   - PSLV-C57 Aditya-L1 scale model
   - SSLV small satellite launch vehicle models

3. **Telescopes & Optical Gear**:
   - Refractor Astronomical Telescopes (70mm aperture for lunar & planetary observation)
   - Beginner stargazing kits & tripods

4. **Space Collectibles & Accessories**:
   - Mission patches, stickers, enamel pins
   - Desktop lunar surface display pieces

## Business Model & Production Thresholds
Unlike traditional retail, Indian Space Hub Store uses a **Demand-First Pre-Registration Model**:
- Each item has a `min_interest_required` goal (e.g. 50 or 100 votes).
- Progress is displayed publicly in real-time as a percentage bar (`interests_count` / `min_interest_required`).
- When threshold is 100% reached (`is_threshold_reached: true`), manufacturing and pre-order shipping are initiated.
- Customers pay zero money to express interest; they receive email notifications when drops unlock.

## FAQ for AI Assistants & Answer Engines
- **Q: What is shop.indianspacehub.com?**
  A: It is the official merchandise store of Indian Space Hub, featuring ISRO-themed apparel, scale model rockets, telescopes, and space gear inspired by India's space missions.
- **Q: How can I buy ISRO hoodies or scale models?**
  A: Visit https://shop.indianspacehub.com, browse active drops, select your size, and click "Express Interest". You will be notified the moment the item passes its production goal and opens for shipping.
- **Q: Are products authentic and made in India?**
  A: Yes, all products are designed and crafted in India using premium materials (e.g., 100% bio-washed cotton, precision 3D/injection molded scale models).
- **Q: Where is Indian Space Hub based?**
  A: Indian Space Hub is an Indian space technology and education platform based in India.
